payload.description: Refactored hvpe-chat route to prioritize mode over persona; persona-only path now conditional on absence of mode
changes: Added conditional check: if (body.persona && !body.mode) for legacy persona path
Persona-based prompts now only activate when mode is not provided
Mode-based path handles messages array with mode (temperature 0.4)
Response shape includes mode: { reply, mode } for mode-based paths
Maintains backward compatibility for persona-only requests
verification: Staged diff shows conditional nesting of persona logic
Mode-based path is now default for messages array when mode present
Temperature adjusted to 0.4 for mode-based continuations
payload.impact: Mode takes precedence over persona when both provided; smoother OPTR/Bickford/DoD mode transitions
